scope: protocol card for the 22.5.1 parent gate on the strongest configuration; zero-training probe and pricing complete, no training authorized

read_code.rule: zeros(24); code[class] = 1.0; both branches receive the same code at joint_readout
read_code.injection: forward hook on joint_readout replaces its output with joint_readout(code); training, evaluation and feedback use the same path
read_code.limitation: the code carries the read's four-way answer, not the scene's pixels; a pass measures byte expression, not content-conditioned binding

criteria.response_round: exact answer bytes plus EOS plus valid UTF-8, greedy, 65-byte cap
criteria.main_denominator: all 32 fit rounds; a failed, extra-byte or invalid round is counted, never filtered
criteria.stability_rule: first-round correct rounds that become wrong <= max(1, 0.10 * first-round correct)
criteria.correction_protocol: one first-pass error released at a time; the released error is re-asked immediately and the next error is only released after it is answered; no error accumulates updates across the round
criteria.control_arm: same subject, same feedback exposure, zero parameter updates and zero state writes; state digest before == after
criteria.feedback_gain: learned second-pass fit accuracy minus control second-pass fit accuracy
criteria.not_identifiable_rule: if first-pass fit errors < 4, correction and feedback gain are recorded as not_identifiable_by_design
criteria.recovery: save the trained bundle, reload in an independent process, re-ask all 32; outputs must be byte-identical
criteria.seed_rule: three seeds, same direction; the world-paired 95 percent lower bound must exceed zero
criteria.world_pairing: each first_A example is an independent world, identified by its own audit.world_digest; the pairing unit is the example, and the bootstrap resamples examples, not rows

authorization.asked: 是否立项 22.5.A.5 协议卡并授权按实价执行

note: probe stage: the manifest exists so the zero-training feasibility probe can run against frozen candidate identities; criteria and pins are frozen before any training reading
